desc: Implement a Fenwick tree class with methods for prefix sum query and point update to manage available positions.
Implement a function to find the k-th smallest available position using binary lifting on the Fenwick tree.
Read input values N and the list P from standard input.
Iterate from i = N down to 1, using the Fenwick tree to find the final position for element i and mark that position as occupied.
Store the result in an array and print the elements separated by spaces.
